nameOrigin: referring to terriers, who get their name from ‘terra’

pokedexEntries.bk: It rescues people stranded by blizzards in the mountains. Its shaggy fur shields it from the cold.

pokedexEntries.wh: This extremely wise Pokémon excels at rescuing people stranded at sea or in the mountains.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: Being wrapped in its long fur is so comfortable that a person would be fine even overnight on a wintry mountain.

pokedexEntries.y: Being wrapped in its long fur is so comfortable that a person would be fine even overnight on a wintry mountain.

pokedexEntries.as: Being wrapped in its long fur is so comfortable that a person would be fine even overnight on a wintry mountain.

pokedexEntries.su: Intelligent, good-natured, and valiant, it’s a trustworthy partner on rescue teams.

pokedexEntries.mo: With this wise Pokémon, there could be no concern that it would ever attack people. Some parents even trust it to babysit.

pokedexEntries.us: It pays no mind to the cold, thanks to its long warm coat. Stoutland in Alola look a little uncomfortable.

pokedexEntries.um: Its fur is long and thick. A long time ago in cold regions, every household kept a Stoutland.

pokedexEntries.sw: These Pokémon seem to enjoy living with humans. Even a Stoutland caught in the wild will warm up to people in about three days.

pokedexEntries.sh: Stoutland is immensely proud of its impressive moustache. It’s said that moustache length is what determines social standing among this species.
